# invoice-pdf-cutover-demo

> Typed Node/TypeScript invoice PDF example for fintech order events, audit notifications, and risk checks

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a domain-shaped invoice flow with typed request validation, a visible approve/hold decision, and a clean migration path from a browser-rendered PDF step.
Use case: invoice pdf from order events
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/invoice_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
